paragraphs: Productive Parks sells web based maintenance management software for parks and recreation. The platform covers asset management, work orders, tasks scheduling, labor tracking, inspections and reporting. Work orders can be received and assigned from internal and external staff.

Inspections can be created, assigned, scheduled and performed without a stated limit. Inventory tracking covers stock levels, reorder points and usage history. Labor hours can be tracked and reported by staff, asset or category. Custom reports and dashboards come from a report engine.
The homepage groups maintenance planning, field inspections, inventory and reports in one platform.

quote.text: Web based Asset Management, Work Orders, Tasks Scheduling, Labor Tracking, Inspections, Reporting and a lot more.
